runtime_uncertainties: Frozen evidence inventory contains no accepted recordings; all selected cases need new construction and proof.
Native junction identity and polygon alone may not establish one statutory median-opening crossing; sourced roadway definition and realized geometry remain to be reviewed.
Native Off state alone is not proof of statutory inoperability or official installed/uncovered signal heads.

Current source-bound measurements cover both entry orders, left-censored occupancy, signal states, ego approach/speed, and opposing-left route intent plus original body-motion agreement; they do not establish a legal yield or exception judgment.

First Off other-first exact inline primary runner/config/four-camera bundle and source-shaped diagnostic now pass pinned offline construction and generated-fixture checks. Positive/negative compatibility, recorded-only process-saved, three distinct fallbacks per selected case, remaining case constructions, semantic proposals and independent delivery audits remain worker-owned.
